## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change (unit tests next to the code; `doctize-tests` for cross-module behaviour)
- [ ] `./gradlew build` passes
- [ ] User-visible changes are described in `CHANGELOG.md` under "Unreleased"
- [ ] Documentation (`doctize-docs/docs`) is updated if behaviour or options changed
